votes.text: Price 74,151 is above the 50-EMA (73,661), and the 20-EMA (73,907) is above it too. Both conditions have to hold, so the averages are stacked in an uptrend.

votes.name: MACD
votes.text: MACD histogram is +11.58. The 12/26 average is above its 9-period signal line and pulling away, which means upward momentum is still being added rather than just present.

votes.name: RSI
votes.text: RSI is 76, above 75: RSI does not vote either way at this level. That never stops a trade on its own - the other votes decide. Tested on 3 years, refusing trades while RSI was this stretched lost money in both test periods: strong trends keep RSI here.

votes.name: VWAP
votes.text: Price is 390.9 pts above VWAP (73,760). VWAP is the average price everyone who traded today actually paid, so above it means the average buyer is in profit — that's the side with the day.

votes.name: PCR
votes.text: No option-chain data is reaching the tool for this index right now, so PCR has no vote. It is not counted against the signal — a missing opinion never raises the bar.

gate.text: ADX is 57.7, at or above the 20 threshold — there is a genuine trend in progress, strong enough that agreement between indicators is likely to mean something rather than being noise.

SENSEX.verdict: 3 of the 3 indicators that had an opinion agree, 0 disagree. At 'strict' strictness that needs at least 3 agreeing and no more than 1 against — met. The trend gate passed. Signal: BUY CE (Call).
levels: STOP 73,829 — the last swing (73,653) is too far away to be a usable intraday stop, so this is capped at 2.0x ATR (161 pts) instead. Risk is 321.74 pts. A stop that wide isn't one you'd actually take, and it would also wreck the reward:risk test by inflating what you're dividing by.

TARGETS 74,586 / 74,912 / 75,238 — set at 40%, 70%, 100% of the 1086.82 pts the market can realistically still travel today. The day's usual range was widened 2x first, because ADX says this is a trending day and trend days routinely run past a normal day's range.
